description:
Create a new Order Type in the Floreant POS Back Office named 'Curbside' (case-sensitive) to handle prepaid contactless pickups. Configure it with the following specific settings:
- Show Table Selection: Unchecked (False)
- Show Guest Selection: Unchecked (False)
- Require Customer Data: Checked (True)
- Prepaid: Checked (True)

Navigate to Back Office > Explorers > Order Types to perform this task. The Back Office PIN is 1111.
